Questions

Quick answers before you buy

Is ₹149 really a one-time payment?
Yes. You pay ₹149 once for lifetime access to PropertyKit. It is not a monthly or yearly subscription.
What exactly do I get?
Add a property and PropertyKit builds a kit of 25 files: 5 Instagram posts, 1 Instagram story, a brochure PDF, a WhatsApp catalogue PDF, captions in English, Hindi and Telugu, an A4 info sheet and a README. You can also open the Design Studio to make and download individual designs in Post, Square or Story size.
Do I need design skills?
No. You only enter property details and upload photos. PropertyKit lays everything out for you and suggests templates that suit your property type.
Can I add my own logo, name and phone number?
Yes. Add your logo, agent name, agency, phone and WhatsApp number once and they appear on your designs, brochure and catalogue.
Can I make designs for more than one property?
Yes. Add as many properties as you like and generate a fresh kit for each one — apartments, villas, plots, commercial spaces and rentals.
Does it work on my phone?
PropertyKit runs in your browser and is built to work on both mobile and desktop. It also works offline, and your property data stays on your device.
Which languages are supported?
Designs and captions are available in English, हिन्दी (Hindi) and తెలుగు (Telugu).
How do I pay, and how do I get access?
Tap any “Get PropertyKit” button to pay securely through Razorpay. After payment you receive your PropertyKit access. If anything looks wrong, message us on Instagram and we’ll help.
I have another question.
Message us on Instagram before you buy and we’ll answer it.
